// One node of a 3D kd-tree. SplitAxis is 0 for X, 1 for Y, 2 for Z;
// otherwise encoded exactly like KdTreeNode2D.
type KdTreeNode3D
    implements IValue
{
    SplitAxis: Integer;
    SplitValue: Number;
    LeftChild: SpatialNodeIndex;
    RightChild: SpatialNodeIndex;
    Items: IntegerInterval;
}

// A kd-tree over a copy of its 3D point set: nearest-neighbor and range
// queries. Node 0 is the root; PointIndices is the leaf-order permutation
// of Points. No builder yet: instances come from a host that emits this
// encoding — see
// tracker/decisions/2026-08-04-spatial-structure-construction-in-plato.md.
type KdTree3D
    implements IValue, ISpatialIndex3D, INearestNeighbor3D
{
    Points: Array<Point3D>;
    Nodes: Array<KdTreeNode3D>;
    PointIndices: Array<ItemIndex>;
}

//==
// # Overlap, intersection, and culling
//
// How one region relates to another, filtered requests for everything inside an
// axis-aligned region, the discrete intersection points of two primitives, and
// the outcome of culling an indexed set against a convex volume. FilterMask is a
// category bitmask combined with a candidate's category bits by bitwise AND
// (non-zero passes), and -1 (all bits set) accepts everything.

// How one region A relates to another region B: no shared points, an overlap
// without full containment, A fully containing B, or A lying fully inside B.
type Containment = Disjoint | Intersects | Contains | Within;

// A filtered request for everything overlapping a 2D axis-aligned region.
type OverlapQuery2D
    implements IValue
{
    Bounds: Bounds2D;
    FilterMask: Integer;
}

// A filtered request for everything overlapping a 3D axis-aligned region.
type OverlapQuery3D
    implements IValue
{
    Bounds: Bounds3D;
    FilterMask: Integer;
}

// The intersection of two 2D primitives
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Intersection_(geometry)): a flag plus the
// discrete intersection points (empty when Intersects is false, or when the
// overlap is a region rather than isolated points).
type IntersectionResult2D
    implements IValue
{
    Intersects: Boolean;
    Points: Array<Point2D>;
}

// The intersection of two 3D primitives: a flag plus the discrete
// intersection points (empty when Intersects is false, or when the overlap
// is a curve or region rather than isolated points).
type IntersectionResult3D
    implements IValue
{
    Intersects: Boolean;
    Points: Array<Point3D>;
}

// The outcome of culling an indexed set against a convex volume (typically a
// camera frustum, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Viewing_frustum): indices
// fully inside, indices straddling the boundary, and the count of items
// rejected outright.
type FrustumCullResult
    implements IValue
{
    FullyVisible: Array<ItemIndex>;
    PartiallyVisible: Array<ItemIndex>;
    CulledCount: Integer;
}

//==
// # Proximity queries
//
// Nearest-neighbor, radius, and closest-point requests with their result
// records. Distances are world-space and non-negative; a MaxDistance that is
// zero or negative means "unbounded", and a MaxCount of zero or less means
// unlimited.

// A k-nearest-neighbors request around a 2D point
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nearest_neighbor_search). NeighborCount is
// the maximum number of results; MaxDistance of zero or less means unbounded.
type KNearestQuery2D
    implements IValue
{
    Center: Point2D;
    NeighborCount: Integer;
    MaxDistance: Number;
}

// A k-nearest-neighbors request around a 3D point. NeighborCount is the
// maximum number of results; MaxDistance of zero or less means unbounded.
type KNearestQuery3D
    implements IValue
{
    Center: Point3D;
    NeighborCount: Integer;
    MaxDistance: Number;
}

// An all-points-within-radius request around a 2D point
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fixed-radius_near_neighbors). MaxCount of
// zero or less means unlimited.
type RadiusQuery2D
    implements IValue
{
    Center: Point2D;
    Radius: Number;
    MaxCount: Integer;
}

// An all-points-within-radius request around a 3D point. MaxCount of zero
// or less means unlimited.
type RadiusQuery3D
    implements IValue
{
    Center: Point3D;
    Radius: Number;
    MaxCount: Integer;
}

// The result of a nearest-neighbor search: parallel arrays of item indices
// (into the caller's item list) and their distances from the query point,
// sorted ascending by distance. Empty arrays mean nothing was in range.
type NearestNeighbors
    implements IValue
{
    Indices: Array<ItemIndex>;
    Distances: Array<Number>;
}

// The closest point on some 2D primitive to a query point. PrimitiveIndex
// identifies which primitive in the caller's list (-1 when the target is a
// single object); Parameter is the normalized position along the primitive
// when it is curve-like, 0 otherwise.
type ClosestPointResult2D
    implements IValue
{
    Position: Point2D;
    Distance: Number;
    PrimitiveIndex: ItemIndex;
    Parameter: Number;
}
